Rule in use: strength over 6 months, stop 3 normal daily moves under the close. I re-test 9 versions every night; 9 pass tonight.
Past test, 80 large stocks together since 2016, five held at a time: 462 trades, 38% won. Winners averaged +13.2%, losers -5.2%, all trades +1.84% each after costs (S&P 500 over the same days +1.04%). Typical hold 16 sessions. Earlier half 2.26%, later half 1.42% a trade. Whole account about 16% a year against 14% for the S&P 500. Best trade +147%, worst -26%.
Caution: the test list is today’s well-known companies, which flatters the past. The paper record below, counted from now on, is the honest test.
FAIR TEST (whole market, collapsed stocks included, 2021-10-12 to 2026-10-14): this version PROVISIONALLY PROMISING. It passed in the newer half at the 0.8% cost. Live paper trades must still confirm it.
Paper record since this list started: 1 finished, 0% won, average -28.6% a trade after costs. Winners averaged none yet, losers -28.6%. Profit factor 0.00 (above 1 means it earns). Best -28.6%, worst -28.6%. Deepest fall of the paper account 5.7%. Under 20 finished trades: too few to judge. If every entry had been filled at the dearest price inside its buy range: average -29.9% a trade.
Costs in these figures: 0.4% a trade (your broker’s 0.15% each way plus the spread). That holds for a position of about 2,000 USD or more; below it the 3 USD minimum fee each way takes a bigger share.
If you buy one, tell me: bought SYMBOL price. I will then trail its stop for you.
